description: Governed semantic topics, distinct from event identity, named-entity roles and related-question families. Each subject has one primary theme. Unknown is an explicit abstention.

subjects.name: Central bank policy rates
anchors: Will the Federal Reserve cut or raise interest rates at its next FOMC meeting?
Central bank interest rate decisions, basis point changes, monetary policy and Fed funds targets.
Will the ECB, Bank of England or Bank of Japan change its policy interest rate?

subjects.name: Central bank leadership
anchors: Who will be appointed the next Federal Reserve chair?
Central bank governor appointments, resignations and leadership succession.
Will the president nominate a new chair of the Federal Reserve?

subjects.name: Consumer prices and inflation
anchors: What will the CPI inflation rate be next month?
Consumer price index, PCE inflation, purchasing power and price growth.
Will annual headline or core inflation exceed the forecast?

subjects.name: Employment and unemployment
anchors: What will the US unemployment rate and nonfarm payroll growth be?
Jobs reports, employment, unemployment claims, wage growth and labor markets.
Will the economy add more jobs than expected in the monthly employment report?

subjects.name: Growth and recession
anchors: Will the United States enter a recession?
GDP growth, economic contraction, recession and economic output.
Will gross domestic product grow or decline this quarter?

subjects.name: Public finance and fiscal policy
anchors: Will the government budget deficit or national debt rise?
Tax rates, public spending, debt ceilings, fiscal policy and government shutdowns.
Will Congress pass a budget to prevent a federal government shutdown?

subjects.name: Armed conflict and territorial security
anchors: Will Russia invade another country or capture territory in Ukraine?
Wars, invasions, military strikes, missiles, armed conflict and territorial control.
Will China invade or blockade Taiwan, or will Israel strike Iran?

subjects.name: Diplomacy and ceasefires
anchors: Will Israel and Hamas agree to a ceasefire or a peace deal?
Diplomatic negotiations, international peace agreements, hostage releases and ceasefires.
Will Russia and Ukraine sign an agreement to end the war?

subjects.name: International trade and sanctions
anchors: Will the United States raise tariffs on imports from China?
Import tariffs, trade agreements, export controls and economic sanctions.
Will a country impose sanctions or remove export restrictions?

subjects.name: Defense and international alliances
anchors: Will a country join NATO or increase defense spending?
Military alliances, NATO membership, defense budgets and security treaties.
Will an international defense alliance admit a new member?

subjects.name: Elections and electoral outcomes
anchors: Who will win the presidential election or the Senate race?
Elections, ballots, electoral votes, party vote shares and campaign results.
Will the Democrats or Republicans win a majority in Congress?

subjects.name: Political leadership and appointments
anchors: Will the prime minister resign, be removed or name a new cabinet?
Presidential succession, political resignations, cabinet appointments and leadership changes.
Who will be the next leader of the political party or head of government?

subjects.name: Legislation and government action
anchors: Will Congress pass a bill or will the president sign an executive order?
Legislation, parliamentary votes, legislative bills and executive government actions.
Will the government enact a new law or change an existing policy?

subjects.name: Immigration and borders
anchors: Will border crossings or deportations exceed the stated threshold?
Immigration policy, asylum rules, migration and border enforcement.
Will the government change visa restrictions or refugee admissions?

subjects.name: Corporate earnings and operations
anchors: Will the company beat revenue or earnings expectations?
Corporate financial results, earnings reports, revenue, profits and business operations.
How many products, cars or subscriptions will the company sell this quarter?

subjects.name: Mergers and acquisitions
anchors: Will the merger or acquisition close by the deadline?
Corporate mergers, takeovers, buyouts and acquisition transactions.
Will one company acquire another company or abandon a merger agreement?

subjects.name: IPOs and public listings
anchors: Will the company launch its initial public offering this year?
IPOs, stock exchange listings, companies going public and direct listings.
When will the private company list its shares on a stock exchange?

subjects.name: Corporate distress and defaults
anchors: Will the company file for bankruptcy or default on its debt?
Bankruptcies, insolvency, Chapter 11 proceedings and corporate credit defaults.
Will a company restructure its debt or enter administration?

subjects.name: Individual equity prices
anchors: Will Apple, Tesla or NVIDIA stock close above a specified share price?
Individual company share prices, stock returns and equity price targets.
Will this company's stock rise or fall by the end of the trading session?

subjects.name: Market indices and volatility
anchors: Will the S&P 500, Nasdaq or Dow close above a specified level?
Stock market indices, VIX volatility and broad equity market performance.
Will the stock market index finish the week higher or lower?

subjects.name: Currencies and foreign exchange
anchors: Will the euro, yen or pound exchange rate strengthen against the dollar?
Currency exchange rates, forex markets, dollar index and currency devaluation.
Will the USD exchange rate exceed the specified threshold?

subjects.name: Bond yields and credit markets
anchors: Will the US ten-year Treasury yield rise above a specified level?
Government bond yields, credit spreads, sovereign debt prices and fixed income markets.
Where will the Treasury bond yield or sovereign credit spread finish the month?

subjects.name: Oil, gas and energy markets
anchors: Will WTI crude oil or Brent close above the target price?
Oil prices, natural gas prices, OPEC production and energy commodity supply.
Will gasoline or natural gas futures rise or fall?

subjects.name: Metals and mining commodities
anchors: Will gold, silver or copper exceed the target price?
Precious metals, industrial metals, mining supply and metal futures prices.
Will the gold price set a record high this year?

subjects.name: Agricultural commodities
anchors: Will wheat, corn or soybean futures exceed the target price?
Agricultural commodities, crop harvests, grain prices and food supply.
Will coffee, cocoa or sugar prices increase this season?

subjects.name: Cryptocurrency prices
anchors: Will Bitcoin or Ethereum trade above a specified dollar price?
Cryptocurrency prices, Bitcoin BTC, Ethereum ETH, Solana and digital asset market returns.
Will bitcoin set a new all-time high or fall below its price threshold?

subjects.name: Digital asset adoption and policy
anchors: Will regulators approve a cryptocurrency ETF or a stablecoin law?
Crypto regulation, blockchain adoption, stablecoins, digital asset legislation and exchange approvals.
Will a company or government adopt bitcoin or launch a cryptocurrency service?

subjects.name: Artificial intelligence and computing
anchors: Which AI model will lead the benchmark or be released next?
Artificial intelligence, machine learning models, AGI benchmarks and semiconductor computing.
Will OpenAI, Google or Anthropic launch a new artificial intelligence model?

subjects.name: Spaceflight and aerospace milestones
anchors: Will SpaceX launch Starship or land a rocket successfully?
Space exploration, rocket launches, satellites, NASA missions and lunar landings.
Will a spacecraft reach the Moon or Mars before the deadline?

subjects.name: Technology products and platforms
anchors: Will Apple release a new iPhone or will a technology platform launch a product?
Software launches, consumer technology products, social media platforms and internet services.
Will a technology service reach a user milestone or release a new feature?

subjects.name: Medicines and drug approvals
anchors: Will the FDA approve the drug or will a clinical trial succeed?
Drug approvals, clinical trials, medicines, biotechnology and medical treatments.
Will a pharmaceutical company receive approval for a new treatment?

subjects.name: Epidemics and public health
anchors: Will a new disease outbreak be declared a pandemic?
Infectious disease cases, epidemics, vaccination rates and public health emergencies.
Will flu, COVID or another infectious disease exceed a case threshold?

subjects.name: Weather conditions and forecasts
anchors: What will the highest temperature or rainfall be in New York tomorrow?
Daily weather, high and low temperatures, precipitation, snow and local forecasts.
Will it rain or snow in the city on the specified date?

subjects.name: Natural disasters
anchors: Will a hurricane make landfall or will a major earthquake occur?
Hurricanes, earthquakes, wildfires, floods and natural disasters.
Will the storm reach category five or cause a major flood?

subjects.name: Climate and energy transition
anchors: Will global emissions or annual average temperatures reach a record?
Climate change, carbon emissions, renewable energy and clean energy transition targets.
Will a country achieve a carbon reduction or renewable electricity milestone?

subjects.name: Association football / soccer
anchors: Will Arsenal win its Premier League football match?
Soccer match winners, FIFA World Cup, Champions League, goals and association football.
Will Barcelona or Real Madrid win the La Liga game?

subjects.name: American football
anchors: Will the Kansas City Chiefs win the NFL game or the Super Bowl?
American football, NFL and NCAA football games, touchdowns and quarterbacks.
Will the college football team cover the point spread?

subjects.name: Basketball
anchors: Will the Lakers win their NBA basketball game?
Basketball, NBA, WNBA and college basketball match winners and player points.
Will the Celtics or Knicks win the basketball championship?

subjects.name: Baseball
anchors: Will the Yankees win the MLB baseball game or the World Series?
Baseball match winners, MLB teams, home runs and pitcher statistics.
Will the Dodgers or Mets win their baseball match?

subjects.name: Ice hockey
anchors: Will the Rangers win the NHL hockey game or Stanley Cup?
Ice hockey, NHL match winners, goals and hockey playoffs.
Will the Maple Leafs or Bruins win the hockey match?

subjects.name: Tennis
anchors: Will Djokovic win the tennis match or the Wimbledon title?
Tennis matches, Grand Slam tournaments, ATP and WTA singles results.
Will Alcaraz or Sinner win the US Open tennis championship?

subjects.name: Golf
anchors: Will the golfer win the Masters or a PGA Tour tournament?
Golf tournaments, PGA, LPGA, birdies and major golf championships.
Who will win the Open Championship golf tournament?

subjects.name: Motorsport
anchors: Will Verstappen win the Formula One Grand Prix?
Formula 1, NASCAR, IndyCar and motor racing race winners.
Which driver will win the F1 drivers championship?

subjects.name: Boxing and mixed martial arts
anchors: Will the fighter win the UFC mixed martial arts bout?
Boxing, MMA, UFC fight results, knockouts and championship belts.
Who will win the heavyweight boxing title fight?

subjects.name: Cricket
anchors: Will India win the cricket match or the ICC World Cup?
Cricket matches, IPL, test cricket, wickets, runs and T20 tournaments.
Will Australia or England win the cricket series?

subjects.name: Esports
anchors: Will the team win the Counter-Strike or League of Legends match?
Esports tournaments, Dota 2, CS2, Valorant and competitive video game match results.
Which team will win the League of Legends world championship?

subjects.name: Other organized sports
anchors: Who will win the Olympic swimming race or the cycling event?
Rugby, volleyball, table tennis, badminton, athletics, skiing and other organized sports.
Will the athlete win a medal at the Olympic Games?

subjects.name: Film and television
anchors: Which movie will win the Oscar or lead the box office?
Films, television shows, Academy Awards, Emmy awards and cinema revenues.
How much will the movie earn on its opening weekend?

subjects.name: Music and music awards
anchors: Which singer will win the Grammy or lead the Billboard chart?
Music albums, songs, artists, record releases and music awards.
Will Taylor Swift release an album or top the music charts?

subjects.name: Games and popular culture
anchors: Will a new video game be released or win Game of the Year?
Video game releases, pop culture, celebrity events and entertainment products.
Will the gaming studio announce a sequel or launch its next game?

subjects.name: Courts and legal proceedings
anchors: Will the Supreme Court rule in favor of the plaintiff?
Court judgments, criminal trials, lawsuits, legal rulings and judicial decisions.
Will the defendant be convicted, acquitted or sentenced?

subjects.name: Regulatory and enforcement action
anchors: Will the regulator impose a fine or bring an antitrust case?
Regulatory enforcement, antitrust investigations, competition law and agency decisions.
Will the FTC or SEC take enforcement action against a company?

subjects.name: Society, religion and demographics
anchors: Who will become the next Pope or lead a religious institution?
Religious leadership, population, education, demographic changes and social milestones.
Will population or university enrollment exceed the forecast?
